text:
[IRET.8.1] **Activation.** When a terminal node receives
a token (from its parent beta node), it creates an
activation and inserts it into the agenda. When the token
is retracted, the corresponding activation is removed.

idris.name: Iret_8_1__settled
idris.note: A table is current: every token settled and every current match has a token -- the agenda [IRET.8.1] maintains.

idris.name: Iret_8_1__tok_settled
idris.note: One token is current: its blocking is what the live `no` facts give and its tuple is a current match.

idris.name: iret_8_1__added_ok
idris.note: Added tokens are current matches.

idris.name: iret_8_1__in_result
idris.note: A current match has a token in the result.

idris.name: iret_8_1__kept_ok
idris.note: Kept tokens are current matches.

idris.name: iret_8_1__now_in_result
idris.note: Every current match has a token after re-propagation.

idris.name: iret_8_1__prop_with_settled
idris.note: The result of re-propagation is settled.

idris.name: iret_8_1__settled_fixed
idris.note: A settled table is a fixpoint of re-propagation: with nothing changed, nothing moves.

idris.name: iret_8_1__added_of
idris.note: Match tuples not seen before become activations, appended in enumeration order; a token whose tuple no longer matches is dropped, which is the clause's removal on retraction.

idris.name: iret_8_1__fresh_tok
idris.note: A new match becomes a new, unfired, unblocked token.

idris.name: iret_8_1__kept_of
idris.note: Tokens whose tuple still matches keep their activation, with its position and `fired`.

idris.name: Iret_8_1__act
idris.note: An activation: the match and whether it has fired.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave
idris.note: What leaves the last node activates the terminal.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate
idris.note: New matches become unfired activations, each at its timetag's place [LDET.5.5].

idris.name: iret_8_1__end
idris.note: When the token is retracted the activation is removed, fired or not.

idris.name: iret_8_1__tuples
idris.note: A terminal's matches, in agenda order.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__terminal_agrees
idris.note: A terminal's activations are FireLoop's unblocked tokens, as a set.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_nil
idris.note: Ending no match keeps every activation.

idris.name: Iret_19__view
idris.note: THE VIEW of an engine: working memory distinct; every alpha memory distinct and equal to its schema's facts passing its tests in working-memory order; every chain consistent from the nil token. Kept by every operation below.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_5__recomputed
idris.note: What the view says of an engine: every alpha memory is its schema's admitted facts, and every terminal holds exactly its chain's recompute over working memory, without duplicates.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_5__recompute_after_history
idris.note: THE VIEW THEOREM, closed at the top: after any history from a loaded network -- every input pumped, in order [LFST.9.2.1] -- incremental propagation has left every alpha memory and every terminal exactly as the recompute over working memory would. Content only: the order theorem of [LDET.5.5] / [LDET.5.9] is the next increment.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_unfired
idris.note: Activating new matches adds one unfired activation per match.

idris.name: iret_8_1__filter_unfired
idris.note: Dropping activations from a terminal with nothing unfired leaves nothing unfired.

idris.name: iret_8_1__insert_unfired
idris.note: Inserting an unfired activation raises the unfired count by one.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_sorted
idris.note: Activating new matches keeps the terminal in agenda order.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_live
idris.note: Removing activations leaves the survivors live.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_sorted
idris.note: Removing activations keeps the terminal in agenda order.

idris.name: iret_8_2__activated_unfired
idris.note: Every activation a terminal gains is unfired.

idris.name: iret_8_2__insert_act_inv
idris.note: An activation after an insert is the inserted one or an old one.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_inv
idris.note: What activating yields is an old activation, or a new match unfired.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_keeps
idris.note: Activating new matches keeps every old activation, as it was.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_new
idris.note: Every new match is there, unfired.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_keeps
idris.note: Ending matches keeps every activation not among them, as it was.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_sub
idris.note: Ending matches adds nothing.

idris.name: iret_8_1__insert_here
idris.note: The inserted activation is there.

idris.name: iret_8_1__insert_inv
idris.note: What inserting yields is the one inserted or an old one.

idris.name: iret_8_1__kept_of_kept_of
idris.note: Kept by the smaller memory's matches after kept by the larger's is kept by the smaller's.

idris.name: iret_8_1__kept_of_map_refresh
idris.note: The kept tokens of a refreshed table are the refreshed kept tokens: keeping reads identities, which a refresh leaves.

idris.name: iret_8_1__kept_sub
idris.note: A token kept by the matches over a sub-memory was kept by the matches over the memory: a match over fewer facts is a match over more.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__seed_unfired
idris.note: A SEEDED TERMINAL holds unfired activations only: the seeding wave creates, and what it creates is unfired.

idris.name: iret_8_1__acts_ext
idris.note: Two activation lists with the same tuples and the same flag on each tuple are one list.

idris.name: iret_8_1__settled_unblocked_set
idris.note: A SETTLED, LIVE TABLE'S UNBLOCKED TUPLES are the unblocked matches: the ids of settledness identify facts under unique ids.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__prop_agree
idris.note: THE UNBLOCKED TOKENS AFTER A PROPAGATION ARE THE NETWORK'S ACTIVATIONS after the same change: the tuples agree because both sides hold exactly the unblocked matches in the key's order and two sorted lists with the same members are one list; the flags agree because an activation whose match survives is kept on both sides, and a released or new match is unfired on both.

idris.name: Iret_8_1__evolves
idris.note: HOW A TERMINAL EVOLVES through some ended and some created matches: every activation afterwards is an old one whose match did not end, or an unfired one for a match created; every old activation whose match did not end is still there. The clause's create-on-arrival and remove-on-retraction, stated as what persists.

idris.name: iret_19_1__insert_flags
idris.note: INSERTING A FRESH FACT: every activation afterwards is an old one or unfired, and every old activation whose match survives is still there, flag and all -- an assertion creates only matches holding the new fact, so no old match is created anew.

idris.name: iret_19_2__dispatch_retract_evolves
idris.note: ALPHA DISPATCH ON RETRACT evolves every terminal ending only matches that hold the fact.

idris.name: iret_19_2__retract_flags
idris.note: RETRACTING A LIVE FACT: every activation afterwards is an old one or unfired, and every old activation whose match survives is still there, flag and all -- a retraction ends only matches holding the fact, and no surviving match holds it.

idris.name: iret_6_4__dispatch_assert_evolves
idris.note: ALPHA DISPATCH ON ASSERT evolves every terminal creating only matches that hold the fact.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_evolves
idris.note: RIGHT-ACTIVATION by a fact creates only matches holding it: the extensions the fact makes, passed down the chain.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_evolves
idris.note: RIGHT-RETRACTION of a fact ends only matches holding it: the extensions it had made, withdrawn down the chain.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_evolves
idris.note: LEFT-ACTIVATION ends nothing and creates what the chain passes.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_evolves
idris.note: LEFT-RETRACTION creates nothing and ends what leaves the chain.

idris.name: iret_8_1__evolves_activate
idris.note: Activating matches: nothing ends, the matches are created unfired.

idris.name: iret_8_1__evolves_end
idris.note: Ending matches: the ended leave, nothing is created.

idris.name: iret_8_1__evolves_refl
idris.note: A terminal evolves to itself through nothing.

idris.name: iret_8_1__evolves_trans
idris.note: Two evolutions compose.

idris.name: Iret_8_1__well
idris.note: A WELL-FORMED TABLE of Rete/FireLoop.idr: every token's facts live, and the tuples in the key's order.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_5__tables_well
idris.note: Every table of a FireLoop state well-formed and settled against its rule.

idris.name: iret_8_1__added_holds_new
idris.note: After a change that adds one fact, every added token holds it.

idris.name: iret_8_1__added_none
idris.note: After a change that adds no fact nothing is added: every current match was a match before, and held.

idris.name: iret_8_1__added_tuples
idris.note: The added tokens' tuples: the current matches not yet held, in enumeration order.

idris.name: iret_8_1__fresh_toks
idris.note: Fresh tokens for a list of tuples; named so that no statement mentions the token builder unapplied.

idris.name: iret_8_1__fresh_tuples
idris.note: Fresh tokens carry their tuples.

idris.name: iret_8_1__kept_live
idris.note: A kept token's facts are live afterwards: its ids are a current match's, and ids identify facts.

idris.name: iret_8_1__kept_well
idris.note: The kept tokens stay well-formed under any memory in which they are live and ordered as before.

idris.name: iret_8_1__new_latest
idris.note: A new activation's match completed at the new fact's position.

idris.name: iret_8_1__nil_before
idris.note: The nil match comes before every match of a fact.

idris.name: iret_8_1__old_before_new
idris.note: An activation created earlier comes before one the new fact completes.

idris.name: iret_8_1__prop_well_grow
idris.note: PROPAGATION AFTER A FACT ENTERS keeps the table well-formed: the kept tokens keep their order under the grown memory; the added tokens, all completed at the new fact's position, follow them in pattern order, which is the key's order among them.

idris.name: iret_8_1__prop_well_shrink
idris.note: PROPAGATION AFTER A FACT LEAVES keeps the table well-formed: nothing is added, and the survivors keep their order under the shrunk memory -- a retraction reorders nothing.

idris.name: iret_8_1__refresh_well
idris.note: Refreshing flags keeps a table well-formed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_5__init_table_well
idris.note: A rule's first table, propagated from nothing over empty working memory, is well-formed: at most the nil tuple.

idris.name: Iret_7_7__consistent
idris.note: The terminal holds exactly what the last node passes, in the consistency relation.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_distinct
idris.note: Activating distinct new matches not already held keeps the activations distinct.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_same_set
idris.note: Activating new matches adds exactly them.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_distinct
idris.note: Ending matches keeps the activations distinct.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_elem_fwd
idris.note: A held activation not ended survives.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_elem_inv
idris.note: An activation surviving an ending was held and was not ended.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_same_set
idris.note: Ending matches removes exactly them.

idris.name: iret_8_1__insert_keeps
idris.note: Inserting an activation into a terminal keeps every activation it held, as it was.

idris.name: iret_8_1__settled_unblocked
idris.note: In a settled table of a rule without `no` patterns no token is blocked.
